name: Komae (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Komae city emblem in white: a stylised angular character like a letter Z.
history: Municipal flag of Komae, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1970.

features.role: Komae city emblem — a stylised angular character like a letter Z
